analysis_plan: rate comparison with denominators MANDATORY (scorer rate() refuses n=0); no peeking before post 6; all 12 posts enter the final analysis regardless of direction

arm_definitions.A_octopus: caption authored by the organism copy engine (luxury Persian-Australian tone) + product photo + ziman-gift.com.au link
arm_definitions.B_baseline: generic one-line caption ('new gift available at our store') + same product photo + same link
arm_definitions.C_sham: omitted — no third arm at zero budget (n insufficient)

hypothesis: octopus-written product captions with a product photo and store link posted to the EXISTING zero-cost Telegram channel produce a higher store-session rate per post than generic baseline captions
n_target_note: 6 per arm, interleaved A/B/A/B over 12 days, 1 post/day
order: MP-ROOTFIX C-3 + phase-4 owner vote (هر دو همزمان) — Ziman free-channel traffic experiment
primary_metric: store_sessions_from_post / post_impressions (tracked via per-post utm tag; sessions via Shopify analytics)
spend_cap: 0 AUD — free channel only; paid ads remain OWNER-FORBID
stopping_rule: stop early only if total add_to_cart >= 3 in either arm (then declare winner) or if any post is reported/removed by the channel
success_threshold: arm A session-rate > arm B session-rate with non-overlapping 80% intervals over the full 12 posts
